routes.reason: Accept as corrected. DiamondsAndVStacks D0 ('Build the missing coherent and algebraic topos interfaces … exactness of sheafification and filtered colimits … derived global sections') is the owner of the spectral-space and coherent-topos inputs: profiniteness of π₀ of a spectral space (197), the reduction of cofiltered limits to ordinal-indexed ones (304), Stacks 02UW for a spectral space with a generic point (394) and SGA 4 VI.8.7.7 on limits of coherent topoi (397). SGA 4 VI 5.2 (598) is already stated by node D0/filtered-colimits-and-cohomology-on-coherent-sites, so it is now planned and named here as a planned item. The review added D5 and item 618, the localization Y_y of a spatial diamond at a point: nodes D5/injection-and-finite-etale-permanence and D5/local-structure-of-etale-maps use it in proof steps, but nothing states it. The three algebraic inputs to Lemma 9.5 were moved out, since D3 does not own them and the DiamondsAndVStacks packet records them as 'not planned in this packet'. The fppf refinement (208) went to SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.2 (route 5), and Raynaud–Gruson over valuation rings of any height (209) to AdicSpacesPartII:R2 (route 6). The lifting of special-fibre points (210) is planned by AdicSpacesPartII:R2/specialisation-map (iii). D3 and D4, to which no item remained, were removed from the stages.

Accept. C2 plans D_ét and the functors of §17 ('Prove presentability and stability with the size bounds and generating/localization argument of 17'), C3 plans Rf_*, C4 plans §18 and C7 plans 20.15–20.16. The D⁺ formula for R_Yét stated after Corollary 17.2 (381), the comparison of Rf_* with the left-completed étale pushforward after Lemma 17.5 (387), Remark 18.2(b) (411) and Proposition 20.14 (464) are all diamond-specific and have no more foundational owner. No stage or node states them. 20.14 is kept missing: C9's 'prove 20.10 and 20.17 and their prerequisites' does not name it, and C7 needs it for the full faithfulness in 20.15, so C7 must state it.

Accept as corrected. S4–S6 own §§23–25. Remark 23.14 (557), the computation Rq^! ≠ q^* after Proposition 24.2 (567), and Remarks 25.5 and 25.6 (578, 579) belong there. Item 604 (Fargues–Scholze IV.3: formally smooth maps have local sections after pullback to strictly totally disconnected spaces) is planned by VStackSheavesAndLisseCategories:VS1 ('Construct formal smoothness and the Jacobian criterion of IV.3–IV.4'), so it left the route. Accept as corrected. EnhancedDerivedSheaves is the atlas's single supplier of ∞-categorical foundations: E3 owns adjoint functor theorems and localisations, and E5:presentability owns presentable ∞-categories. HTT 5.5.3.12 and 5.5.3.13 (407, 611; limits of presentable ∞-categories along colimit-preserving functors, to be planned together) and Neeman's compact-objects criterion (603) belong there. The HabiroRings packet independently records HTT 5.5.3.13 as owned by no stage. The claim that 'neither yet states HTT 5.5.2.2' was false. Node E5:presentability/presentable-categories states that a functor C → S^op out of a presentable C is representable if and only if it preserves colimits, so item 406 is planned and stays in the route only as a named planned item.

Accept as corrected. SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.2 ('Own Zariski, etale, fppf and pro-etale site comparisons; construct sheaf cohomology, localization, proper/smooth base change and compact support') owns scheme étale cohomology in the atlas. Accepted briefs (Bhatt–Mathew, Clausen–Mathew–Morrow) import base change from it. Proper base change for schemes (441) is therefore planned, not missing, and stays as a named planned item. Invariance of scheme étale cohomology under extension of algebraically closed fields (614), a corollary of smooth base change that no layer states, belongs here. So does Grothendieck's refinement of fppf covers of strictly henselian local rings by finite flat ones (208, moved from route 1), a scheme-theoretic input to the fppf/étale comparisons that SF.2 owns. No other roadmap owns these: WeilConjectures, EtaleDualityAndPerverseSheaves and LefschetzPencilsAndVanishingCycles consume SF.2.

New source route added by the review, to AdicSpacesPartII:R2 (a proposed roadmap, not Tau Ceti). R2 owns formal schemes over valuation rings, and AdicEtaleGeometry:A2 defers formal schemes to AdicSpacesPartII. Node R2/flat-tft-is-tfp proves that a flat topologically finite type O_K-algebra is topologically finitely presented for a complete rank-one O_K, and its hypotheses note 'Fujiwara–Kato: any height'. Lemma 9.5 needs the statement over C⁺ of any height (209), so R2's blueprint must state it in that generality. The lifting of special-fibre points to O_C-points (210) is planned by R2/specialisation-map (iii) (Bosch–Lütkebohmert I 3.4–3.5, with K = C algebraically closed) and is named as a planned item.

notes: Accept, with the extraction corrected in place. The review read arXiv:1709.07343v4 (14 April 2026, 'final version to appear in Astérisque'), SHA-256 78ca42bb…33efc as recorded, 168 pp. The printed page equals the PDF page. Six section passes covered §§1–6, 7–10, 11–13, 14–17, 18–21 and 22–27, and every source issue and every formula that mattered was checked on 300-dpi page images. Five status passes checked every library and planned item (all 594): every cited declaration was opened at Mathlib 082e2d3 and Tau Ceti f790474, and every cited stage and node was read. One routes pass searched the libraries and the atlas for every missing item, and one pass compared arXiv v1–v4 and searched the literature for corrections; none exists, and the Astérisque version has not appeared. Items: 16 statements, 7 locators, 8 names and 96 notes corrected; items 618 (localization Y_y, missing) and 619 (Pro(Y_ét,qc,sep) basis, planned at C0) added. Statuses: 210, 406, 441, 598 and 604 were missing but are planned (AdicSpacesPartII:R2, EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E5:presentability, SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.2, DiamondsAndVStacks:D0, VStackSheavesAndLisseCategories:VS1). Planned lists were shortened for 193, 334, 366 and 505. No planned item plans only a special case: the diamond layers were written from this paper by statement number, and the v4 numbering matches. Counts: 619 items, 581 planned, 19 library, 19 missing. Routes: route 2 accepted; routes 1, 3, 4 and 5 accepted as corrected (route 1's Lemma 9.5 inputs moved to SF.2 and to AdicSpacesPartII:R2); route 6 (AdicSpacesPartII:R2) added and accepted. Mistakes: E1–E73 all confirmed (field corrections to E5, E12, E27, E32, E43, E46, E50, E63; atlas ids in `known` qualified by packet, since PerfectoidSpaces--P0 and --P8 reuse E1–E34). E74–E101 were added (28). Five affect a stated result: E74 (Theorem 1.8(iii), A and B swapped), E83 (the warning before Proposition 8.3: 'X → ∗ quasicompact ⇒ X quasicompact' fails in X_proét for X an infinite disjoint union of points), E94 (the unbounded case of Theorem 19.2 omits 'f quasi-pro-étale or nΛ = 0'), E99 (Proposition 22.15 needs Ỹ quasiseparated) and E100 (Propositions 24.2–24.3 omit 'Λ ℓ-power torsion'). There are six proof gaps, among them E88 (Proposition 13.13: open and closed neighbourhoods of a point of |Y|^B are not cofinal, since the Berkovich quotient of the perfectoid disc is connected), two errors that affect nothing (Remark 16.2; Remark 25.6's example fails for K = Q_p) and 15 misprints. The section pass proposed recording E57 as affecting nothing; the review kept 'a stated result', consistent with E66 and E68. Prerequisites: Huber 1993 removed (already a source of the ClassicalAdicEtaleCohomology H0 packet); SGA 4 Exposé VI added.
